title: WTF is: LoRA?
author: fisj
selftext:
I kept seeing LORA being mentioned and I didn't know what it is. Sharing some notes:

LoRA is a highly efficient way to finetune models. If you want to finetune stable diffusion so that it specializes on a particular character, or style, then this technique will allow you to do more on a gpu with less VRAM (10GB), in less time.

References:

1. Using LoRA for Efficient Stable Diffusion Fine-Tuning  
[https://huggingface.co/blog/lora](https://huggingface.co/blog/lora)
2. LORA: Install Guide and Super-High Quality Training - with Community Models!!!  
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9MT1n97ITaE](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9MT1n97ITaE)
3. How To Do Stable Diffusion LORA Training By Using Web UI On Different Models - Tested SD 1.5, SD 2.1  
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mfaqqL5yOO4](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mfaqqL5yOO4)
4. ULTIMATE FREE LORA Training In Stable Diffusion! Less Than 7GB VRAM!  
[https://youtu.be/70H03cv57-o](https://youtu.be/70H03cv57-o)

PS. Sorry for all the stable diffusion posts, but it far out paces progress in GPT right now. Longer term I expect we'll see a lot more interesting progress across the gamedev spectrum.
